title: Abduction and implant prevalence estimates

tellings.quote: Well, the people that they implant uh they they've they've abducted about 3% of the American population according to Dr. L.

plain: On a Jesse Michels podcast episode about a scientist who studies what people call alien implants, small objects said to be placed in human bodies by non-human beings, a guest named Steve Coburn gives a number. He says that, according to a doctor he calls Dr. L, named as Roger Leer, about 3 percent of Americans have been taken by these beings, and some of them were given implants. If true, it would mean millions of people have been affected.
